mapper.select: SELECT REVIEW_CODE, PRODUCT_CODE, REVIEW_SCORE, REVIEW_INFO, INSERT_DT, INSERT_USER_ID, UPDATE_DT, UPDATE_USER_ID FROM TB_REVIEW WHERE PRODUCT_CODE = #{productCode}

SELECT SUM(TOP5_PRICE) AS TOTAL_PRICE FROM( SELECT (tp.SALES * tp.AMOUNT) AS TOP5_PRICE FROM TB_PRODUCT tp WHERE tp.KEYWORD_CODE = (SELECT KEYWORD_CODE FROM TB_PRODUCT WHERE PRODUCT_CODE = #{productCode}) AND tp.PLATFORM = 'PLATFORM_01' order by TOP5_PRICE desc limit 5 ) as TOTAL_PRICE
